title: New industries: steel, oil and cars
goal: See how governments and foreign companies built new industries in Latin America, and say how it was done with mediante.

items: I can name the state companies that were created, such as Pemex and Petrobras.
I can say why steel was important for industry.
I can describe the car and appliance factories that opened.
I can say how governments helped industry.
I can say how something was done with mediante + noun.
